verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִים כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ šîr miz·mō·wr hā·rî·‘ū lê·lō·hîm kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A song A Psalm Make a joyful noise to God all the earth
verses.literalPt: Aclamai a Deus, todas as terras. Cantai a glória do seu nome,

verses.original: זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד־ שְׁמ֑וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ כָ֝ב֗וֹד תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- šə·mōw śî·mū ḵā·ḇō·wḏ tə·hil·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Sing the glory of His name make His praise glorious
verses.literalPt: rendei-lhe glória em cântico de louvor.

verses.original: אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭אלֹהִים מַה־ נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ בְּרֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ לְךָ֣ אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im·rū lê·lō·hîm mah- nō·w·rā ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā bə·rōḇ ‘uz·zə·ḵā yə·ḵa·ḥă·šū lə·ḵā ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Say to God How awesome are Your deeds So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You
verses.literalPt: Dizei a Deus: Quão terríveis são as tuas obras! Pela grandeza da tua força, se submeterão a ti os teus inimigos.

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאָ֤רֶץ׀ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ־ לָ֑ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·ḵā wî·zam·mə·rū- lāḵ yə·zam·mə·rū šim·ḵā se·lāh
verses.literal: All the earth bows down to You they sing praise to You they sing praise to Your name Selah
verses.literalPt: Toda a terra te adorará e te cantará louvores. Eles cantarão o teu nome. (Selá)

verses.original: לְכ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū ū·rə·’ū mip̄·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm nō·w·rā ‘ă·lî·lāh ‘al- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Come and see the works of God how awesome are His deeds toward mankind
verses.literalPt: Vinde e vede as obras de Deus; terrível é ele nos seus feitos para com os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם׀ לְֽיַבָּשָׁ֗ה בַּ֭נָּהָר יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄aḵ yām lə·yab·bā·šāh ban·nā·hār ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇə·rā·ḡel šām niś·mə·ḥāh- bōw
verses.literal: He turned the sea into dry land they passed through the waters on foot there we rejoiced in Him
verses.literalPt: Converteu o mar em terra seca; passaram a pé através do rio; ali, nos regozijamos nele.

verses.original: מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל בִּגְבוּרָת֨וֹ׀ עוֹלָ֗ם עֵ֭ינָיו בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה הַסּוֹרְרִ֓ים׀ אַל־ יָרִימוּ לָ֣מוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šêl biḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯōw ‘ō·w·lām ‘ê·nāw bag·gō·w·yim tiṣ·pe·nāh has·sō·wr·rîm ’al- yå̄·rī·mū lā·mōw se·lāh
verses.literal: He rules forever by His power His eyes watch the nations Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves Selah
verses.literalPt: Ele impera pelo seu poder para sempre; os seus olhos estão de vigia sobre as nações. Não se exaltem os rebeldes. (Selá)

verses.original: בָּרְכ֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְ֝הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rə·ḵū ‘am·mîm ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·haš·mî·‘ū qō·wl tə·hil·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Bless our God O peoples let the sound of His praise be heard
verses.literalPt: Bendizei, ó povos, a nosso Deus; e fazei que se ouça a voz do seu louvor.

verses.original: הַשָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ בַּֽחַיִּ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ נָתַ֖ן לַמּ֣וֹט רַגְלֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śām nap̄·šê·nū ba·ḥay·yîm wə·lō- nā·ṯan lam·mō·wṭ raḡ·lê·nū
verses.literal: He preserves our lives and keeps . . . our feet from slipping
verses.literalPt: O qual preserva em vida a nossa alma e não permite que vacile o nosso pé.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בְחַנְתָּ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗נוּ כִּצְרָף־ כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇə·ḥan·tā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣə·rap̄·tā·nū kiṣ·rāp̄- kā·sep̄
verses.literal: For You , O God have tested us You have refined us like silver . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois tu, ó Deus, nos tens posto à prova; tens nos afinado, como se afina a prata.

verses.original: הֲבֵאתָ֥נוּ בַמְּצוּדָ֑ה שַׂ֖מְתָּ מוּעָקָ֣ה בְמָתְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḇê·ṯā·nū ḇam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh śam·tā mū·‘ā·qāh ḇə·mā·ṯə·nê·nū
verses.literal: You led us into the net You laid burdens on our backs
verses.literalPt: Fizeste-nos entrar no laço do caçador; pesada carga puseste sobre as nossas costas.

verses.original: הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְרֹ֫אשֵׁ֥נוּ בָּֽאנוּ־ בָאֵ֥שׁ וּבַמַּ֑יִם וַ֝תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נוּ לָֽרְוָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hir·kaḇ·tā ’ĕ·nō·wōš lə·rō·šê·nū bā·nū- ḇā·’êš ū·ḇam·ma·yim wat·tō·w·ṣî·’ê·nū lā·rə·wā·yāh
verses.literal: You let men ride over our heads we went through fire and water but You brought us into abundance
verses.literalPt: Fizeste que os homens cavalgassem sobre as nossas cabeças; passamos pelo fogo e pela água, mas nos trouxeste para a abundância.

verses.original: אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְךָ֣ בְעוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְךָ֣ נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇō·w ḇê·ṯə·ḵā ḇə·‘ō·w·lō·wṯ ’ă·šal·lêm lə·ḵā nə·ḏā·rāy
verses.literal: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings I will fulfill my vows to You
verses.literalPt: Entrarei na tua casa com holocaustos, pagar-te-ei os meus votos,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ פָּצ֥וּ שְׂפָתָ֑י וְדִבֶּר־ פִּ֝֗י בַּצַּר־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- pā·ṣū śə·p̄ā·ṯāy wə·ḏib·ber- pî baṣ·ṣar- lî
verses.literal: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress
verses.literalPt: os quais os meus lábios proferiram, e a minha boca prometeu, quando eu estava na angústia.

verses.original: עֹ֘ל֤וֹת מֵחִ֣ים אַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֭ךְ עִם־ קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה בָקָ֖ר עִם־ עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·lō·wṯ mê·ḥîm ’a·‘ă·leh- lāḵ ‘im- qə·ṭō·reṯ ’ê·lîm ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḇā·qār ‘im- ‘at·tū·ḏîm se·lāh
verses.literal: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings with the fragrant smoke of rams I will offer bulls and goats Selah
verses.literalPt: Oferecer-te-ei holocaustos de reses gordas, com incenso de carneiros; oferecerei novilhos com cabritos. (Selá)

verses.original: לְכֽוּ־ שִׁמְע֣וּ וַ֭אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־ יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- šim·‘ū wa·’ă·sap·pə·rāh kāl- yir·’ê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Come and listen all you who fear God and I will declare what He has done for me
verses.literalPt: Vinde, ouvi, vós todos que temeis a Deus, e declararei o que tem feito por minha alma.

verses.original: אֵלָ֥יו פִּֽי־ קָרָ֑אתִי וְ֝רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lāw pî- qā·rā·ṯî wə·rō·w·mam ta·ḥaṯ lə·šō·w·nî
verses.literal: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue
verses.literalPt: A ele clamei com a minha boca e exaltei com a minha língua.

verses.original: אָ֭וֶן אִם־ רָאִ֣יתִי בְלִבִּ֑י לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע׀ אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·wen ’im- rā·’î·ṯî ḇə·lib·bî lō yiš·ma‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāy
verses.literal: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart the Lord would not have listened
verses.literalPt: Se eu atender à iniquidade no meu coração, o Senhor não ouvirá.

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên šā·ma‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm hiq·šîḇ bə·qō·wl tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: But God has surely heard He has attended to the sound of my prayer
verses.literalPt: Mas, na verdade, Deus tem ouvido, tem atendido à voz da minha oração.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הֵסִ֘יר תְּפִלָּתִ֥י וְ֝חַסְדּ֗וֹ מֵאִתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer lō- hê·sîr tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî wə·ḥas·dōw mê·’it·tî
verses.literal: Blessed be God who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Bendito seja Deus, que não rejeitou a minha oração, nem de mim apartou a sua benignidade.
